description: PENDING (runtime staged). The Format 3 (exception-checking) PERFORM (ISO 14.9.28.2 Format 3 / 14.9.28.4 GR14-22) - a per-statement exception interceptor scoped to imperative-statement-1 that dispatches a raised exception condition to a matching WHEN handler in written order (new-in-2023). Fully recognized/validated (COBOL1597-1617) + introduction-gated (COBOL0900 below 2023, recognition-fired from VersionConformancePass.ParseArm.VisitPerformStatement on a performWhenPhrase, disjoint from the perform-until-exit-2023 gate), but the runtime handler dispatch is a documented next-wave GAP - at 2023 the construct is currently rejected with COBOL0899 (staged), so no 2023 program compiles yet. status flips to active + expectDiagnostic drops when the interceptor wave lands.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMPERF3.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 N PIC 9 VALUE 0.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    PERFORM
        ADD 1 TO N
    WHEN EC-SIZE
        DISPLAY "S"
    END-PERFORM.
    STOP RUN.
